Travel to find the second mesmer trainer.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
| profession = Mesmer
| primary = y
| secondary = n
}}

===Objectives===
* Look for [[Lo Sha]] in [[Kinya Province]].

===Reward===
* 600 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
Travel northwest from [[Sujun]] through the mountains until you reach Kinya Province. Once there, go a short distance southwest and you will find Lo Sha.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Mei Ling
:''<Character name>, you have performed very well so far. I believe you are ready to move on to your next lesson. '''Lo Sha''', a fellow Mesmer instructor, is waiting for you in '''Kinya Province'''. Where Mesmer training is concerned, he is very accomplished; you can learn a lot from him. But he has a tendency toward bitterness, so try not to let it distract you.''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll look for Lo Sha in Kinya Province.
| decline = I think I need a break.
| ask = '''Lo Sha''' awaits you in '''Kinya Province'''. Tardiness will not improve his attitude.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Lo Sha
:''I hope Mei Ling has not poisoned your mind with her blind devotion to Headmaster Kaa. That doddering fool should have been replaced long ago.''

:''All right, I'll continue your training from here.''
